title: R' Yaakov bar Achai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reports in the name of R' Yonatan in Yelammedenu, Ki Tisa, section 4, as cited in Seder HaDorot. Hyman suggests that perhaps he is R' Yaakov bar Acha, who reports in R' Yonatan's name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ס״ד is contextually section/siman 4, not speculative 64; ס״הד is contextually Seder HaDorot. Both remain interpreted source labels without fresh edition/locus verification; Ki Tisa expands source תשא, and no otherwise absent teachings are inserted.

Achai/Acha preserve different forms. ואולי is Hyman’s tentative identity suggestion, not an adopted merge. All four abbreviated personal titles remain R', without title transfer from either side of the conjecture.
